hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are sweating over a freak double injury blow to Hincapie and Zubimendi ahead of the Lille Champions League tie, while simultaneously revelling in Manchester United's ongoing implosion—because nothing soothes the nerves like watching your rivals combust.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment plummeted sharply across the day, shifting from morning schadenfreude over Manchester United's struggles (7/10) to afternoon crisis mode (4/10) after defensive targets Piero Hincapié and Martín Zubimendi suffered training injuries days before a Champions League tie. The early glee at rivals' misfortunes and confidence in Arteta's project evaporated under the weight of VAR fury, a missed transfer target (Rio Ngumoha), and a pervasive 'here we go again' fatalism.

weekly.summary: The week began in euphoria following Arteta's contract extension but deteriorated sharply into aggrieved fury, as on-pitch struggles, injury crises, and unresolved Man City charges transformed structural optimism into a sense of farce. A dramatic sentiment collapse saw the fanbase swing from championship swagger to incensed grievance, with only fleeting respites from women's team results or youth performances. The dominant arc traces a complete unraveling of the early-week project stability narrative.
